definitions.usage: base, contemn, despise, lightly esteem, set light, seem vile.
definitions.full: H7034. qalah II. [ קָלָה ] verb Niph`al belightly esteemed, dishonoured (|| form of קלל ; compare Late Hebrew קְלנָא ᵑ7 קָלוֺן, disgrace, shame) ; — Perfect 3masculine singular consecutive וְנִקְלָה Isa 16:14 ; Deut 25:3 ; Participle נִקְלֶה Isa 3:5 2 t.; — be lightly esteemed , held of little account, 16:14 (glory of Moab); וְנִקְלֶה רָשׁ אִישׁ 1Sam 18:23 ; so ( Participle as substantive) Isa 3:5 (opposed to נִכְבָּד ), Prov 12:9 (opposed to מִתְכַּבֵּד ); more positively, be dishonoured , degraded, Deut 25:3 ( עֵינֶיךָ ). Hiph`il treat with contempt, dishonour, Participle וגו אָבִיו ׳מַקְלֶה Deut 27:16 one dis-honouring [i.e. opposed to כַּבֵּד of 5th Command].
